name: rx-field
title: Field (React)
description: Form-layout family - Field, FieldLabel, FieldTitle, FieldDescription, FieldError, FieldContent, FieldGroup, FieldSet, FieldLegend and FieldSeparator. Composes a label, a control, helper text and an error into one accessible unit, plus choice cards (a Field inside a FieldLabel around a radio or checkbox).
